Generate a multiple-select question with exactly 5 answer options (A, B, C, D, E) where 2 or 3 options are correct. Return a single valid JSON object with the following fields: - "questionText": string, the full question (phrase it to indicate multiple answers, e.g. "Select all that apply") - "options": array of 5 objects each with "id" (A/B/C/D/E) and "text" (the answer choice) - "correctAnswer": JSON array of 2 or 3 option ids that are all correct (e.g. ["A","C"]) - "explanation": string, 2-3 sentences explaining which options are correct and why the others are not
Example output: { "questionText": "Which of the following are valid Apex trigger events? (Select all that apply)", "options": [ {"id": "A", "text": "before insert"}, {"id": "B", "text": "after undelete"}, {"id": "C", "text": "before query"}, {"id": "D", "text": "after update"}, {"id": "E", "text": "before merge"} ], "correctAnswer": ["A", "B", "D"], "explanation": "Apex supports before/after insert, update, delete and after undelete events. 'before query' and 'before merge' are not valid trigger events in Salesforce." }
